title: Dataset association on GenAI metrics is gated on is_managed_dataset in _run_harness
answers: which datasets get linked to genai evaluation metrics
should I pass any dataset object to genai evaluate harness
dataset_name only set for managed datasets in genai evaluate
body:
Invariant: In _run_harness, the dataset handed to the harness is `mlflow_dataset if is_managed_dataset else None`. Only managed evaluation datasets are recorded on logged-model aggregate metrics.
Enforced at: mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness (the harness.run call site).
What breaks if skipped: passing a raw list/DataFrame (or an unmanaged object without a name/digest) into log_metrics can attach an invalid or misleading dataset reference to metrics, and changes behavior for users who never supplied a managed dataset.
When editing this path, keep the is_managed_dataset check in place rather than always forwarding the dataset.
applies: Changes to how _run_harness forwards dataset info into harness.run and metric logging.
says: Evaluation metrics show incorrect dataset tags when evaluating models on raw data.
Only attach dataset information to evaluation metrics when using official managed datasets.
Model aggregate metrics display misleading dataset references after running evaluation without datasets.
Prevent unmanaged data tables or lists from being tagged on evaluation metrics.
Evaluation metrics should leave dataset references empty when unmanaged data is evaluated.
search: In mlflow/genai/evaluation/base.py:_run_harness, dataset association on GenAI evaluation metrics is restricted to managed datasets via mlflow_dataset if is_managed_dataset else None. When invoking harness.run, only managed evaluation datasets are recorded on logged-model aggregate metrics. Forwarding raw lists, DataFrames, or unmanaged objects lacking a name or digest into log_metrics attaches misleading dataset references and changes behavior for users without managed datasets. When editing this path, the is_managed_dataset check must be kept rather than unconditionally forwarding the dataset.
